assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms
and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
This service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that are not captured on standard monitoring
directly supporting the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation
